title: Spotlight counts presses on the owner's own link list, not only on Link cards

source.ref: Space function scan 2026-11-17 (project thread: Trace every Space feature end to end)

detail: Click counts (LIVE-856) cover only Link cards (book, contact, product, Journey, event, membership). The Links block, the free list of URLs that is what a link-in-bio is, renders plain anchors with no beacon (components/entity-blocks/content-block-view.tsx, and the themed layouts that draw facts.links), and the click endpoint's TARGET pattern refuses any other target. Production 2026-11-17: 6 published Space Spotlights, 1 Space click ever (2026-11-03); Daniel's own Spotlight carries 15 links in a Links block and its console shows no counts for any of them. Fix needs a stable per-link target (a short hash of the URL survives reordering), a counted anchor in the Links renderer and the themed link layouts when inSpotlightRender(), the console mapping those targets back to the link labels, and the hosted /spotlight-click path on a website host. Closed 2026-11-17: each link in a Links block now counts as `link:<hash of its address>` on a published Spotlight (ContentBlockView through CountedCardLink, and the themed layouts through one CountedLinkScope wrapper that matches the owner's link addresses), the click endpoint admits that target, and the console maps it back to the link's saved label, on the same /api/spotlight/click or hosted /spotlight-click path as the cards. Two links with the same address share one count, and a Button or other anchor inside a themed layout that points at the same address as one of the owner's links counts as that link.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
